positions.role: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Architecture and Security
positions.description: Own delivery, security and architecture for a multi-surface fintech mobility platform: consumer, partner and admin web apps and a mobile API over a service backend, covering money movement, identity and regulated payments compliance.
achievements: Removed a critical authentication bypass and migrated stored credentials to modern hashing, verified on the live path.
Closed money-correctness defects in locality routing and currency precision across the financial surfaces, and added idempotency that fails closed on every money path.

Built the card top-up rail on Mastercard Payment Gateway Services hosted sessions, so card data never reaches our servers, and the M-Pesa, MTN and Tigo mobile money rails with per-country routing. Mapped controls to PCI DSS SAQ-A.

Designed the release process: immutable releases, symlink activation, a post-deploy smoke that rolls back automatically, and a release guard on money-path files. Deploy and rollback are each one command.

Designed a cross-product trust score engine with signed partner event ingestion, a tamper-evident ledger and a nightly recompute, rolled out behind feature flags to the admin console, rider portal and mobile API.
Hardened access and the SDLC: key-only SSH, MFA for admins, audit trails, secret scanning and test gates in git hooks, pentest remediation, encrypted off-site backups with restore drills.
Rebuilt three front-end surfaces in typed, tested React, documented the API surface, and author the architecture decision records that name trade-offs and failure modes.

positions.role: Team Lead, Platform and Quality Engineering
positions.company: ENGIE Energy Access, later Ignite Energy Access
positions.description: Pay-as-you-go solar platform serving seven African markets with millions of daily transactions.
achievements: Designed the event-driven payment architecture: RabbitMQ-backed bounded contexts for payment, token and subscription that decoupled the synchronous PAYG lifecycle and removed peak-load timeouts across all seven markets.

Instrumented tracing and monitoring across Ruby and Node.js services (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, ELK) with SLOs and error budgets; detection of payment anomalies fell from hours to under five minutes. Built the Redshift and Kafka telemetry and payment reporting pipeline.

Led the shift-left quality programme: Playwright and Cypress suites covering 900 critical-path scenarios across payments, tokens, IoT provisioning and subscriptions. Regression fell from three days to 45 minutes; releases rose from 2 to 12 a week.

Led the Rails 5 to 7.2 upgrade underpinning payment processing, PAYG token dispatch, IoT diagnostics and firmware updates, including a staged rollout and an incident rollback with no customer-facing downtime.
Line-managed four engineers across Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania; two were promoted to senior during my tenure.

positions.description: Founded and shipped an ML security and robustness platform for software in medical devices (SiMD and SaMD), where model failure has patient-safety implications. Ran concurrently with Baw Bab.
achievements: Architected the backend: FastAPI orchestration, a Rust and PyO3 evaluation core, Go middleware for rate limiting and worker coordination, and GPU evaluation workers on AWS with idempotent workers and dead-letter queues.
Shipped ML pipelines combining CNNs, retrieval-augmented generation and graph neural networks to detect adversarial attacks on medical ML models, orchestrated with Airflow and tracked with MLflow.
Built compliance tooling that maps model evaluation results to FDA, HIPAA and IEC 62304 requirements, with LLM-generated regulatory documentation, in a category with few established vendors.
Operated the production stack (SQS, SNS, Kinesis, hosted Kafka) and carried on-call for customer-facing evaluation SLAs.

positions.description: Digital addressing infrastructure for last-mile delivery in African urban areas without formal addresses. Ran concurrently with Vishnu Systems.
achievements: Led a five-engineer team and shipped the Nairobi County Government pilot serving 2.3 million residents, the second digital addressing programme in Africa, integrated with the county land registry.
Designed the computer vision and GIS pipeline over Azure, Google and OpenStreetMap satellite imagery that converts residential structures to Google Plus Codes, tuned for low-bandwidth field use.

Owned the stack: Node.js APIs, a mobile-first React front end for field agents, Google Cloud Vision and GIS services on a Pub/Sub event bus, MongoDB and Kafka for spatial data, deployed on GCP Cloud Run and Azure.
Contributed pipelines to TruStacks, an open-source DevOps orchestration platform of declarative delivery stacks: dependency fetching, tests, builds, staging and security scanning across frameworks.

positions.description: Small team delivering internal applications for reinsurance operations across several countries, each localised with country-specific roles and access.
achievements: Delivered features test-first with Jest, and end-to-end coverage with Cucumber, Puppeteer and Cypress, on a hybrid Scrum and Kanban cycle with after-hours support duty.
Worked across the MERN and MEAN stacks (React, Angular, Node.js, MongoDB) and the legacy Grails and Groovy services with PostgreSQL.
Time taken for health and wellbeing and for structured professional development, including certifications in cloud, AI and security.

positions.description: Fintech and e-commerce SaaS for small businesses in Kenya, delivered by a freelance team I led and mentored.
achievements: Built C2B and B2B cloud products on Reactive Spring with Angular and on the MERN and MEAN stacks, on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes, with M-Pesa payments and multi-currency support.
Ran the mentorship programme that grew the team: 15 developers mentored through code review, system design and career coaching, six of whom moved to mid or senior roles.

Wrote C and embedded assembly for petabyte-scale video streaming pipelines with deterministic store-and-replay and zero frame loss, and designed the redundant data paths and self-healing recovery for content delivery.

positions.description: Application security platform for static, dynamic and composition analysis of customer code.
achievements: Built and extended the customer integrations, including the Jira and Visual Studio plugins and the Jenkins and GitLab CI integrations, so customers could run scans and receive findings inside their own pipelines.
Worked on the core platform in Java (Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Hibernate), C# .NET and Python on Docker, Kubernetes and AWS, including the TLS 1.2 enforcement upgrade for regulated customers.

Built the Selenium test automation for IBM Web Experience Factory with the principal architect and QA lead, integrated it into the Jenkins pipelines with Python and Bash, and built the reporting that separated real failures from false positives.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
